units.scope: Definition4.1, Proposition4.2 full proof and Theorem4.3 full proof

scope_checks: Classical psh Definition4.1 quantifies every analytic extension and every analytic curve map. Ground-field curve tests alone are insufficient.
Theorem4.3 good strict and nontrivially valued assumptions must be checked for semipositive R-PL recognition.
Theorem6.5 requires the actual pointwise limit to be upper semicontinuous; it does not license usc regularization of arbitrary upper envelopes.
Theorem6.1 local maximum propagation is at interior points. Relative boundary cannot be omitted.

Theorem6.4 printed proof says continuous in its maximum-set step although theorem only assumes classical psh/usc; upper semicontinuity is enough to make its global maximum set closed. This is an applicability observation, not a textual correction.
